Hi Keiko (and Samir),

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood — excited to show the inference flow and latency profiles for your Tokyo and SG workloads. I put together a short agenda (attached) and a couple of proposed times that try to hit reasonable business hours across Tokyo / Singapore / Sydney.

Proposed slots (all local times listed in parentheses):
- Option A: Tue May 25, 10:30 JST / 09:30 SGT / 11:30 AEST (35–45 mins)
- Option B: Tue May 25, 18:00 JST / 17:00 SGT / 19:00 AEST (short walkthrough + Q&A)

Quick ask: which of these works for your team? Also flag if anyone needs us to avoid overlap with end-of-day in Sydney (we can move earlier). I attached a one-page agenda and will follow up with an invite once we lock a slot.

Thanks,

Heads up: Samir is in Singapore and I am in Tokyo, so Option A (10:30 JST / 09:30 SGT) should be fine for us, but the time in Sydney (11:30 AEST) is early afternoon on Tue — our Sydney partner reps are in a different rotation and may not be available until 14:00 AEST.

Could we instead do Option A but move it 90 minutes later so it lands at 12:00 JST / 11:00 SGT / 13:00 AEST? That keeps it within business hours for all three locations.

Also, quick question — are your times DST-aware? Australia has just shifted clocks in some regions and we want to make sure the invite lands correctly in our calendars.

Best,
